column3: “The great priest” is rendered “the high priest,” and “the accuser” (the satan) is rendered as the name “Satan.”
“The accuser” is rendered “Satan”; “piece of firewood” is rendered “brand,” and NASB adds “Indeed.”
“Robes” is rendered “festal robes”; “and he said” is rendered “Again he said.”
“Keep my charge” is rendered “perform My service,” and “guard” “have charge of”; “goings” is rendered “free access,” and NASB adds “here.”
“Companions” is rendered “friends,” and “men of sign” “men who are a symbol”; “branch” is capitalized “the Branch,” and NASB adds “in.”
“Engrave its engraving” is rendered “engrave an inscription on it.”
